messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=canary-deploys-prod severity=critical; incident_id=INC-2026-4312; trigger=canary-failure rate spike. https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-4312

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-4312 triggered -> escalation policy 'eng-oncall' -> page sent to asha.

asha (on-call): ack'd on phone, pulling up canary dashboards now :eyes:

tom: seeing a sustained error rate on quant-node-02 for model-serving v2.4.7, p50 latency up 230ms, p95 up 1.2s. HTTP 503s from embed endpoint.

asha (on-call): confirm - canary group (10% traffic) shows 18% 5xx over last 3m. Prod baseline 0.2%.

ops-sre: looks like this started right after the rollout step 'quant-kernel-update' at 10:12 UTC. K8s events show OOMKilled on model-worker-quant-02 twice.

tom: attaching recent logs snippet:

```
2026-03-12T10:12:34Z quant-node-02 model-worker[pid=4521]: exception: KVCacheResizeError: attempted resize during active requests
2026-03-12T10:12:34Z quant-node-02 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4521 (model-worker)
2026-03-12T10:13:01Z quant-node-02 model-worker[pid=4602]: endpoint /v1/embeddings -> 503 Service Unavailable
```

asha (on-call): @ops-sre can we isolate quant-node-02 from canary traffic and trigger a rollback for the canary? We need to stop customer-facing errors.

ops-sre: isolating now — switching traffic for canary bucket to fallback pool. Command run:
```
kubectl label nodes quant-node-02 maintenance=true --overwrite
kubectl patch svc embed-canary -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"role":"embed-fallback"}}}'
```

ops-sre: traffic diverted. Confirming new requests hitting fallback pool.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-4312 acknowledged by asha. Escalation paused.

tom: starting rollback of deployment canary: v2.4.7 -> v2.4.6. Will kick staged rollout back to previous revision.

asha (on-call): TL;DR customer impact - short window ~10:12-10:18 UTC, approx 4,200 affected requests, 12% of canary sessions saw transient 503s. No confirmed customer data loss.

leila: taking notes for post-incident RCA and affected-customer list. Will open a customer impact ticket after we stabilize.

ops-sre: rollback command issued:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=202603120946-v2.4.6 --namespace=prod
```

ops-sre: rollout progressing: 3/4 pods replaced, old revision back, liveness checks passing.

tom: monitoring telemetry — error rate dropping to baseline on canary now. p95 latency back to normal.

asha (on-call): good. I'll keep the incident open for 30m to validate. @leila can you prepare the timeline and who to notify?

leila: on it. I'll collect the deploy logs, kernels, and commit diff for quant-kernel-update. Planning an internal postmortem with eng-runtime and infra tomorrow.

incident-bot: Note: automated mitigation applied (traffic diversion + rollback). Please update INC-2026-4312 with next steps.

ops-sre: leaving a follow-up action: drain quant-node-02 and run memory/kv-cache stress tests before reintroducing. Ticket created: INFRA-9876.

asha (on-call): switching handoff to leila in 25m — staying available if anything regresses.

leila: acknowledged. I'll be primary for the RCA and customer comms.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-4312 status -> monitoring.

asha (on-call): closing loop here — rollback successful, traffic stable, no further customer-facing errors observed. Will publish short incident note and schedule RCA. :white_check_mark:

leila: thanks team.

ops-sre: adding follow-up ops runbook entry for 'quant-kernel-update canary checks'.

incident-bot: This thread has been updated with mitigation tags: rollback, traffic-diversion, follow-up-ticket=INFRA-9876.
